title: Ronald Ueyn Apple ulushini 1976 yilda 800 dollarga sotgan
hook: Ronald Ueyn Apple'dagi 10 foiz ulushini 800 dollarga sotgan.

scenes.text: 1976 yilda Ronald Ueyn Apple'dagi 10 foiz ulushini atigi 800 dollarga sotib yubordi.
U kompaniyani Stiv Jobs va Stiv Voznyak bilan ochgan, ilk logotipni ham chizgan.
scenes.keywords: hand drawing sketch with pen on paper

scenes.text: Ikki haftadan kam vaqt o'tib u qarzga javob berishdan qo'rqib, sherikchilikdan chiqdi.
scenes.keywords: worried man signing document at table

scenes.text: Hisob-kitoblarga ko'ra, bugun o'sha ulush yuz milliardlab dollar turishi mumkin edi.
Ba'zan tavakkaldan qo'rqish xatodan qimmatga tushadi.

description:
Ronald Ueyn 1976 yil 1 aprelda Stiv Jobs va Stiv Voznyak bilan Apple'ni ochdi va 10 foiz ulush oldi. Ikki haftadan kam vaqt o'tib u shaxsiy qarz xavfidan qo'rqib, ulushini 800 dollarga qaytarib berdi. Hisob-kitoblar taxminiy: Apple qiymatiga qarab yuz milliardlab dollar.

Bu saboq sizga kerakmi? Izohda bitta so'z bilan yozing.
source: Fact-check 2026-11-12 (web search). Partnership signed 1 Apr 1976; Wayne held 10%, wrote the partnership agreement and drew the first logo (Newton under the apple tree). He left within two weeks (about 11-12 days; sources differ by a day, so scene 3 now says 'ikki haftadan kam') because the partnership carried unlimited personal liability for debts. Paid $800, later $1,500 more to drop claims. FIXED: old line said the stake would be worth 'o'n milliardlab' dollars, which understates it; Fortune gives a range of about $75bn to $360bn, other 2026 reports about $400bn (simple 10% of market cap, ignores dilution), so the line now says 'yuz milliardlab' with 'mumkin edi'. Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ronald_Wayne ; https://fortune.com/article/apple-cofounder-sold-10-percent-stake-for-800-dollars-would-be-worth-400-billion-today/ ; https://www.washingtontimes.com/news/2026/apr/28/apples-third-founder-ronald-wayne-sold-10-stake-800-1976-no-regrets/ ; https://www.notebookcheck.net/Ronald-Wayne-left-Apple-12-days-after-founding-it.1272116.0.html
